applications.title: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer
applications.jd_text: Looking for Embedded Firmware Engineer with expertise in ARM Cortex-M bare-metal C, FreeRTOS, zero-copy DMA circular UART, I2C 9-clock recovery, CAN Bus fault state machines, and hardware watchdog supervision.

interview_questions.a: I built a 9-clock bus-clearing sequence with hardware reset line toggling to dynamically recover from slave-device clock stretching freezes in noisy industrial environments.
